# OneBonsai Gulf

> OneBonsai Gulf is an AI company in Abu Dhabi focused on consulting, engineering, and custom software development. We help UAE and Gulf organizations select valuable AI use cases, integrate AI with existing systems, implement governed AI agents, develop workforce capability, and create immersive training.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://obgulf.com/): Company positioning and core capabilities
- [Services](https://obgulf.com/services): AI consulting, integration, agentic AI, custom software, training, and VR simulation
- [System integration](https://obgulf.com/services/system-integration): Enterprise application, API, event, data, cloud, and AI integration in the UAE
- [Cybersecurity](https://obgulf.com/services/cybersecurity): Security architecture, application and cloud security, AI controls, and incident readiness
- [Application development](https://obgulf.com/services/application-development): Web, mobile, internal, and AI-enabled application delivery in Abu Dhabi and the UAE
- [AI experts on demand](https://obgulf.com/services/ai-experts-on-demand): Project, fractional, embedded, and full-team AI capability from a vetted specialist network
- [Digital twins & simulation](https://obgulf.com/services/digital-twins-simulation): Operational modelling, industrial simulation, and repeatable procedure training
- [UAE market entry](https://obgulf.com/services/uae-market-entry): Abu Dhabi entity setup, licensing, visas, introductions, representation, and technical execution
- [Industries](https://obgulf.com/industries): Sector-specific opportunity areas and operating considerations
- [Work](https://obgulf.com/work): Custom software development, enterprise AI, and immersive training work delivered from Abu Dhabi
- [Insights](https://obgulf.com/insights): Practical UAE AI implementation and industry guides
- [About](https://obgulf.com/about): Company, founder, delivery model, and team
- [Contact](https://obgulf.com/contact): Direct business enquiry information

## Editorial standard

Our guidance distinguishes general operational information from legal, regulatory, clinical, engineering, cybersecurity, and financial advice. Sector and legal requirements should be verified for the organization and use case. Official sources are linked where current public policy or regulation is discussed.

## Evidence

- More than 80,000 people have trained on immersive solutions across the OneBonsai group.
- More than 70 case studies and work for more than 49 clients have been delivered across the OneBonsai group.
- OneBonsai Gulf is a strategic partner of Masdar City Free Zone in Abu Dhabi.
- Four ready-made VR modules, Fire, First Aid, Hazard Spotting, and Cybersecurity, each include an AI avatar.
- AI experts on demand are selected from a curated network of more than 50 vetted AI and IT specialists, local and international.
